name: com.samcarlton.ecosystem/tulsa-ecosystem-map
title: Tulsa Ecosystem Map
description: Search Tulsa and Oklahoma's startup ecosystem. Results include map page citations.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List sourced tag pages, including Startups and the Greenwood network, with entry counts and page citations.

tools.name: get_tag
tools.description: List entries with a sourced tag, Tulsa entries first. Includes page citations for the list and its entries.

tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Search Tulsa Ecosystem Map entries by name, alias or rough spelling. Matches include a summary, page citation and id for get_entry.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. 'SAFE note' or 'venture studio'.

kinds.description: Only entries of all these kinds, e.g. ['investor'].

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Get an entry by id, with its definition, example, funding evidence, official site, public connections, source URLs and map citation.

id.description: An entry id from search_entries, e.g. 'techlahoma'.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the map's categories with entry counts, page citations and ids for get_category.

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: List a category's entries, Tulsa entries first, with page citations and entryClass on each member. typeTabs shows the available type pages and their full entry counts.

id.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. 'fundraising'.

tools.name: list_kinds
tools.description: List the kinds with browse pages, entry counts and page citations.

tools.name: get_kind
tools.description: List entries of one kind, Tulsa entries first, with summaries and page citations for the list and its entries.
